Disagreeing Politely in German: B1 Phrase Practice

Express a different view politely in German. Practise Ich sehe das anders, Einwand and partial agreement without hiding your position.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Useful phrases and patterns

You can acknowledge part of a point and then state a different view: Ich verstehe den Gedanken, sehe aber ein Problem. Meiner Meinung nach marks a view as your assessment. A specific objection is easier to discuss than a personal judgement or an unclear hint.

Common mistake to avoid

Do not confuse a polite tone with agreement. If you disagree, make the point clear and explain which part you question.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Ich verstehe den Gedanken, sehe aber ein Problem bei der Umsetzung.I understand the idea but see a problem with implementation.
Worked example 2Meiner Meinung nach sollten wir die zweite Möglichkeit prüfen.In my opinion we should examine the second option.
Worked example 3Da stimme ich Ihnen teilweise zu; beim Zeitplan habe ich einen Einwand.I partly agree with you there; I have an objection about the schedule.
Worked example 4Ich sehe das etwas anders und würde es gern begründen.I see that a little differently and would like to explain why.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the disagreement phrase using the indicated word or expression. Keep the distinction between agreement and objection. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: anders · Einwand · nach · zu

Question 1. Ich sehe das etwas ___. (differently)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: anders

Anders makes the different assessment explicit.

Question 2. Meiner Meinung ___ ist der Plan zu knapp. (opinion phrase)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: nach

The fixed phrase is meiner Meinung nach.

Question 3. Beim Budget habe ich einen ___. (objection)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: Einwand

Einwand names a specific objection.

Question 4. Da stimme ich Ihnen nur teilweise ___. (zustimmen, prefix)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: zu

Zustimmen separates into stimme ... zu.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
